description: Golden ShotSpec for the Order 66 council-chamber opening (Episode 3, 'Order 66'): the reveal/ambush/cascade grammar that the beat_profiles table was modeled on. Used by the engine golden test to pin that the content-driven LLM path produces a verified, concrete plan whose scene/camera/lighting/motion events match the directorial grammar.

content.prose: The Council chamber: a wide hall of senators, the air still, instruments dimmed.
beats: wide: the hall is quiet, senators seated - a low ambient hum
close-up: Qui-Gon's hand goes to the lightsaber - the hum drops out
medium: the clones turn as one, blades raised - first blaster crack
